metadata.scenario: A patient follows up on their recent medical test results that they have not yet received. Category: Follow-up.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Robert Jackson. I’m following up on some medical test results I haven’t received yet. Hi Robert! I remember you. I hope you’re doing well. Which tests are you referring to? It was the tests my neurologist ordered last week. I was hoping to have the results by now. I understand how important that is, especially with your condition. Let me check our records. Thank you. I really need to know if there are any changes we should be aware of. Of course, just a moment... Okay, I see that the results are not yet in our system. Oh, I see. Should I reach out to the neurologist’s office directly? That might be a good idea. They could provide more immediate information. Right, I’ll do that. Could you also confirm if my last visit was noted correctly in your system? Yes, your last visit was three days ago, and you received personal care and nursing as usual. Perfect. I wanted to make sure everything was documented properly. Absolutely, it’s crucial for your ongoing care. Is there anything else on your mind? Actually, yes. I wanted to ask if I could get additional personal care hours for next week. Sure, we can arrange that for you. How many extra hours are you thinking? I’d like to add about four more hours, if possible. That would be around $112 to $140 based on our rate for personal care assistance. That sounds good. Can you confirm that for me? Yes, I’ll put in a request for four additional hours. You’ll receive a confirmation shortly. Great, I appreciate your help with that. No problem at all, Robert. Just remember to follow up with the neurologist. I will, thank you for the reminder. You’re welcome! Have a wonderful day, Robert. You too, Margaret. Goodbye! Goodbye!
